compatibility.public_field_union: existing standard plus retained FMP Data; no added fields
compatibility.query_change: New bounded FMP variant; one required symbol, strict extras. Other providers unchanged.

incompatibilities.retained_source_defect: Epoch0/changePercentage0 converted to null; UTC timezone stripped.
incompatibilities.approved_correction: Preserve zeros and UTC awareness; public union unchanged.
incompatibilities.migration: UTC-aware ISO timestamps include +00:00; never interpret as local time.

limitations: No live calls; account entitlement and consumer behavior unverified.
Not point-in-time safe; publication/vintage and restatement unknown.
Empty array succeeds distinctly from unavailable optional values and response validation failure.
Currency is not inferred from symbol, exchange or profile.
last_timestamp identifies quoted data, not market-cap/share-count date.
Bid/ask/close/previous close distinct; no missing-value substitution.
No retained currency; currency/share prices with currency unknown.

transformations.name: unix_seconds_utc
transformations.source_basis: Documented Unix timestamp; retained UTC conversion.

source_evidence.epoch_semantics: Official FMP Quote API education reference identifies timestamp as Unix timestamp of quoted data; conversion uses UTC Unix seconds. Retained converter used UTC then stripped timezone.
